propositions: The shipped per-criterion fan-out recovery explodes token cost (22 criteria × 20-request budget = 440 requests worst case) and wall-clock cost (sequential 25–90s per criterion), discarding verified work from primary runs that fail before completion.

A criteria-scaled primary step floor verify_step_floor(c) = clamp(8c, 48, 480) replaces the flat 480-step ceiling, making typical tickets converge without entering recovery by eliminating 10x over-budget allocation that drives runaway exhaustion.

Incremental criterion verdicts are banked deterministically at verification time using run-scoped git-ignored storage, enabling successor recovery to resume only over unverified criteria in batches bounded by resolved model class (standard ≤8, frontier ≤12), with a request budget pool = 1.5 × N where N = ceil(floor/2).

The finalizer always emits full-coverage verdicts from banked evidence plus unverified met=false placeholders on any typed primary failure, and falls back to deterministic no-LLM assembly (certifiable=false) if the LLM finalizer itself fails, eliminating the verdict-less --force-close trap.

Path-normalized read_file memo caching (lever 2) collapses 77% re-read waste by caching whole-file content once per path and slicing all ranges from cache within a single run, retaining exact-signature memoization for other tools.

Coverage validation merges banked and successor verdicts by criterion ID order-insensitive, with retry-on-missing, and successor preflight fails loud on ticket/material/tree stamp mismatch, ensuring resumable recovery correctness.
